our_interpretation: Read the comparison as concerning image generation systems, rather than all AI systems.
Graphics means visual fidelity and rendering quality. World models and comprehension mean observable physical coherence, compositional correctness, and understanding of requested content.
Interpret the last few years approximately as 2022 through publication.
The claim compares improvements over time. A remaining gap in absolute performance does not by itself establish different rates of improvement.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evaluations across the target years show sustained visual-quality gains and materially smaller gains in physical coherence, compositional correctness, or content understanding.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations show that the relevant understanding capabilities improved as much as or more than visual quality, or that the asserted sustained visual-quality improvement did not occur.

evidence.explanation: The authors' assessment is consistent with Marcus's distinction between attractive rendering and remaining reasoning weaknesses. It does not measure whether reasoning improved less over the same years; the paper does not specify exact experiment dates.

The study reports that prompt optimization improves measured compositional performance. This makes fixed, selected prompts an uncertain basis for comparing underlying capabilities over time, but does not establish the opposite historical trend.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A longitudinal comparison of relevant model generations using stable visual-quality and semantic or physical-correctness evaluations, with a defensible method for comparing their gains.
